p: The DeferShape class extends the Shape class and serves as a specialized geometric shape that supports deferred rendering with customizable properties such as corner rounding and selective corner modification.
h3: Radius (float): Defines the radius used to round the corners of a shape. This property determines the degree of curvature applied, with larger values resulting in more pronounced rounding.

Corners (Corner) = Corner.All: Specifies the corners of a shape to which a radius or modification is applied. This property determines which corners of the shape will be rounded or affected during rendering.

pre.code: public override void Render(Gui gui, LayoutNode node, SKCanvas canvas)

p: Renders the current shape onto the specified canvas using the provided GUI and layout node.

ul.li: gui (Gui): The GUI instance providing context for the rendering operation.
node (LayoutNode): The layout node defining the position and dimensions for rendering.
canvas (SKCanvas): The canvas where the shape will be drawn.

pre.code: public new static DeferShape Rect(float left, float top, float right, float bottom)

p: Creates a rectangular shape with specified boundaries.

ul.li: left (float): The x-coordinate of the left edge of the rectangle.
top (float): The y-coordinate of the top edge of the rectangle.
right (float): The x-coordinate of the right edge of the rectangle.
bottom (float): The y-coordinate of the bottom edge of the rectangle.
A DeferShape instance that represents the rectangular shape.

pre.code: public static DeferShape DrawRectFilled(Color color, float radius, Corner corners = Corner.All)

p: Creates a rectangular shape filled with a specified solid color, with options for rounded corners and a configurable radius.

ul.li: color (Color): The color used to fill the rectangle.
radius (float): The radius of the rounded corners. Set to 0 for square corners.
corners (Corner): Specifies which corners of the rectangle should be rounded. (Default: Corner.All)
A DeferShape representing the filled rectangle with the specified attributes.
